pages: Hine, a girl of thirteen, black hair in a ponytail, a grey school sweatshirt with the sleeves turned back, bends over the kitchen table and writes in one notebook with a black elastic band round it. Middle distance: an open muesli box and a glass of milk. Background: the kitchen window, flat morning light.

Hine, a girl of thirteen, black hair in a ponytail, a grey school sweatshirt with the sleeves turned back, stands barefoot on one round white bathroom scale and looks down at it. Middle distance: the elastic-banded notebook on the tiles by her foot. Background: the bathroom window, one bare bulb at night.

Hine, a girl of thirteen, black hair in a ponytail, a grey school sweatshirt with the sleeves turned back, tips one white bowl of muesli against her open palm and looks at how far the flakes sit above the rim. Middle distance: the kitchen scales and a glass jar of almonds. Background: the kitchen bench, morning light.

Hine, a girl of thirteen, black hair in a ponytail, a grey school sweatshirt with the sleeves turned back, sits on the back step holding one glass jar of almonds and stares at the nuts in her palm. Middle distance: the kitchen scales and a spoon on the step. Background: the open back door and flat grass, low sun.

Hine, a girl of thirteen, black hair in a ponytail, a grey school sweatshirt with the sleeves turned back, stands in a corridor looking up at one wall chart of coloured bars, her notebook shut under one arm. Middle distance: a plastic waiting bench and her school bag. Background: the corridor window, cool daylight.

Hine, a girl of thirteen, black hair in a ponytail, a grey school sweatshirt with the sleeves turned back, leans on a corridor windowsill holding one muesli bar still in its paper sleeve, not eating it yet. Middle distance: a bank of lockers and her school bag on the floor. Background: the corridor glass, flat school light.

Hine, a girl of thirteen, black hair in a ponytail, a grey school sweatshirt with the sleeves turned back, sits up in bed and looks at one square bedside clock with glowing hands. Middle distance: her running shoes on the floor and the elastic-banded notebook on the desk. Background: the bedroom window and a dark street.

Hine, a girl of thirteen, black hair in a ponytail, a grey school sweatshirt with the sleeves turned back, taps one wall calendar with a fingertip and stands thinking in the hallway. Middle distance: her running shoes and the elastic-banded notebook on a shelf. Background: the front door, morning light.

Hine, a girl of thirteen, black hair in a ponytail, a grey school sweatshirt with the sleeves turned back, sits in the front row of a plain club room, both hands flat on one closed notebook in front of her. Middle distance: a stopwatch on the next chair and a gym bag. Background: the window above the shop, evening light.

Hine, a girl of thirteen, black hair in a ponytail, a grey school sweatshirt with the sleeves turned back, sits at a table before one white plate, hands flat on either side, naming what she is about to eat. Middle distance: a stopwatch lying face up and a set of kitchen scales. Background: a plain wall, warm lamplight.

Hine, a girl of thirteen, black hair in a ponytail, a grey school sweatshirt with the sleeves turned back, adds up three days of figures in the open notebook on her knee. Middle distance: the kitchen scales and a clean white plate on the table. Background: the window of the room upstairs, late afternoon light.

Bel Kaur, a woman in her forties with black hair tied back and a navy tracksuit top, leans over one open notebook on the table and taps a run of blank days. Middle distance: a stack of white plates and a set of kitchen scales. Background: the window of the room above the shop, evening light.

Bel Kaur, a woman in her forties with black hair tied back and a navy tracksuit top, turns one cardboard muesli box over in both hands, frowning at it. Middle distance: the open notebook and a glass jar on the table. Background: a bare wall and a low window, warm light.

Hine, a girl of thirteen, black hair in a ponytail, a grey school sweatshirt with the sleeves turned back, turns one cardboard muesli box over in her hands and frowns at it. Middle distance: the open notebook and a spoon on the table. Background: the window of the club room, flat evening light.

Hine, a girl of thirteen, black hair in a ponytail, a grey school sweatshirt with the sleeves turned back, sits back in the chair with one hand flat on her stomach and the other holding the open notebook. Middle distance: a white plate and a glass of water. Background: the club room window, last light.

Hine, a girl of thirteen, black hair in a ponytail, a grey school sweatshirt with the sleeves turned back, sits at a kitchen table eating slowly from one breakfast plate, a fork in her right hand. Middle distance: a stopwatch lying face up and a piece of cheese on a small plate. Background: the kitchen window, morning light.

Bel Kaur, a woman in her forties with black hair tied back and a navy tracksuit top, rests one flat hand on her own stomach as she talks across the table. Middle distance: a breakfast plate and a kitchen timer. Background: the club room wall and its window, warm light.

Hine, a girl of thirteen, black hair in a ponytail, a grey school sweatshirt with the sleeves turned back, looks down at one dinner plate and counts what is on it on her fingers. Middle distance: an apple and a muesli bar still in its sleeve. Background: the kitchen table and a window, late afternoon light.

Hine, a girl of thirteen, black hair in a ponytail, a grey school sweatshirt with the sleeves turned back, writes a short list in one notebook with a black elastic band round it, the band stretched on the table. Middle distance: a lidded jar of almonds and a tablespoon. Background: the kitchen window, evening light.

Hine, a girl of thirteen, black hair in a ponytail, a grey school sweatshirt with the sleeves turned back, runs on her toes past a tape on the grass, looking down at the stopwatch on her wrist. Middle distance: a marker cone and a folded track jacket. Background: the school field and low sun.

Hine, a girl of thirteen, black hair in a ponytail, a grey school sweatshirt with the sleeves turned back, stands at the edge of the field reading one small notebook in her hand. Middle distance: a track spike and a water bottle on the grass. Background: the running track and hedges in full sun.

Hine, a girl of thirteen, black hair in a ponytail, a grey school sweatshirt with the sleeves turned back, writes a single number in one notebook with a black elastic band round it, pen held in her teeth. Middle distance: her water bottle and a track spike on the grass. Background: the field edge in sun and shadow.
